description: Battery storage arbitrage margin for a day on the German-Luxembourg day-ahead market (EPEX SPOT DE-LU hourly prices): for a 1, 2 or 4 hour battery, the cheapest charging hours and the most expensive discharging hours, the daily price spread and the gross margin per MW of power after round-trip losses (default 88%). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
